title: Bank Creation with Valid Data
description: Verify that a bank can be successfully created with all mandatory fields correctly filled and valid formats.

steps.description: Navigate to Add Bank page as Admin user.
Fill bank creation form with valid bankName, dbaName, routing number (9 digits), numeric zip code, and valid account number.
Select valid account type and corporation.
Submit the form.
Bank is created successfully and listed in the banks database.

title: Bank Creation with Missing Mandatory Fields
description: Verify that bank creation fails when any mandatory field is missing.

steps.description: Navigate to Add Bank page as Admin user.
Leave one mandatory field empty such as bankName, dbaName, routing number, zip or account number.
Try to submit the form.
Form validation prevents submission and shows appropriate error message for the missing field.

title: Bank Creation with Invalid Routing Number Format
description: Verify that bank creation fails when routing number is not exactly 9 digits.

steps.description: Navigate to Add Bank page as Admin user.
Enter routing number with less or more than 9 digits.
Fill other fields with valid data.
Try to submit the form.
Form validation prevents submission and displays a routing number format error.

title: Bank Creation Prevents Duplicate DBA Name
description: Verify that duplicate DBA names are rejected when creating a new bank.

steps.description: Create a bank with a specific DBA name.
Attempt to create another bank with the same DBA name.
Submit the form.
System rejects creation and shows duplicate DBA name error.

title: Super Admin Signature Upload with Valid PNG/JPEG
description: Verify that Super Admin can upload and assign digital signatures to banks with valid file formats and preview functionality.

steps.description: Log in as Super Admin.
Navigate to Signature Management page.
Select a bank needing a digital signature.
Upload a PNG or JPEG digital signature file.
Preview of the uploaded file is visible.
Assign the signature to the selected bank.
Signature is successfully assigned and saved to the bank record.

title: Signature Upload Rejects Invalid File Types
description: Verify that signature uploads are rejected when file types other than PNG or JPEG are used.

steps.description: Log in as Super Admin.
Go to Signature Management page and select a bank.
Attempt to upload a file with invalid type (e.g., PDF, GIF, BMP).
Upload is blocked and error message is shown indicating invalid file type.

title: Admin Cannot Upload or Overwrite Digital Signatures
description: Verify that Admin users do not have permission to upload or overwrite digital signatures.

steps.description: Log in as Admin user.
Navigate to Signature Management page.
Access is denied or upload button is not visible.
Attempt to overwrite an existing signature assigned to a bank (e.g., via API call).
Operation is rejected with a permission error.

title: Add User Page Shows Only Unassigned Banks with Live Search
description: Verify that the Add User page displays only banks with no assigned user, supports multi-select checkboxes, and live search filters results.

steps.description: Log in as Admin user.
Navigate to Add User page.
Banks listed are only those where assigned_to_user_id is null.
Use the live search input to filter banks by partial dbaName or bankName.
The list dynamically updates to match search terms.
Select multiple banks using checkboxes.
Selected banks remain selected upon filtering/unfiltering the list.

title: User Creation Assigns Selected Banks Correctly
description: Verify that when creating a user and selecting multiple unassigned banks, the banks get assigned to that user upon save.

steps.description: On Add User page, fill user details with valid data.
Select multiple unassigned bank checkboxes.
Submit the user creation form.
The user is created successfully.
Selected banks have their assigned_to_user_id updated to the new user's ID.

title: Unassigned Banks API Returns Correct Data
description: Verify that the unassigned banks API endpoint returns only banks with null assigned user IDs, including id, dbaName, accountType, and bankName.

steps.description: Send GET request to Unassigned Banks API endpoint.
Response status is 200 OK.
Response JSON includes only banks where assigned_to_user_id is null.
Each bank object includes fields: id, dbaName, accountType, and bankName.

title: Assign Banks API Updates User Assignments Correctly
description: Verify that the API to assign banks to a user updates the assigned_to_user_id field for each bank correctly and enforces security.

steps.description: Send POST request to Assign Banks API endpoint with valid user ID and list of unassigned bank IDs.
Response status is 200 OK with success message.
Each specified bank record is updated with assigned_to_user_id set to the given user ID.
Attempt same request as unauthorized user or with invalid role.
Response returns a 403 Forbidden or authentication error.

title: Cheque Printing Includes All Required Bank and Signature Details with Auto-incremented Check Numbers
description: Verify the cheque printing process pulls correct bank data, includes the digital signature image, auto-increments cheque numbers uniquely per bank, and prints correct return address.

steps.description: Initiate cheque printing for a bank that has a digital signature assigned.
Cheque print output includes the bank name, DBA name, account number, routing number, and return address details.
Digital signature image is correctly rendered on the cheque.
Cheque number is auto-incremented from the last printed cheque number for that bank.
Print multiple cheques consecutively and verify cheque numbers increment sequentially and uniquely per bank.

title: JWT Authentication and Role-Based Access Control Enforce Permissions
description: Verify that JWT tokens are required for all protected API routes, and roles (Super Admin vs Admin) enforce access restrictions accordingly.

steps.description: Attempt to access protected API endpoints without JWT token.
Requests are rejected with 401 Unauthorized.
Access protected API routes with valid JWT token as Admin, try to perform Super Admin-only actions.
Access is denied with 403 Forbidden.
Access routes with Super Admin token and verify all allowed.
Super Admin actions succeed.

title: Add User Page Handles No Unassigned Banks Gracefully
description: Verify that if there are no unassigned banks available, the Add User page displays appropriate message and disables bank selection.

steps.description: Ensure all banks are assigned to users in the database.
Navigate to Add User page.
Page shows message indicating no unassigned banks found.
Bank selection checkboxes are disabled or hidden.

title: Check User Creation Fails When Required User Data Is Missing
description: Verify that user creation form enforces mandatory user fields and prevents submission when data is incomplete.

steps.description: Navigate to Add User page.
Leave mandatory user fields blank (e.g., username, email).
Attempt to submit the form.
Form shows validation errors and prevents submission.
